About.title: About TOGT Tour & Travel
About.body: TOGT Tour & Travel is a full-service, IATA-accredited travel agency based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. For years we have guided pilgrims to Umrah, connected travelers to the world through official airline ticketing, and welcomed visitors to explore Ethiopia's rich heritage.

Umrah.title: Umrah Packages
Umrah.subtitle: Economy, VIP, Honeymoon, or fully Custom — travel to the Holy Cities with peace of mind.
Umrah.giftBody: Send a full or half-sponsored Umrah package to a loved one, friend, or top performer.

WhyTogt.title: Why TOGT Is Different
WhyTogt.iataBody: Direct access to official airline ticketing systems — no middlemen, transparent fares.
WhyTogt.experienceBody: Thousands of pilgrims and travelers served across Umrah, tours, and visa processing.
WhyTogt.supportBody: Real humans and AI assistance whenever you need us, in your language.

Ticket.title: Ticket Office
Ticket.body: As an IATA member, we issue, reissue, and refund flight tickets through official airline systems — with transparent fares and dedicated support.

Domestic.title: Domestic Tours
Domestic.subtitle: School trips, honeymoons, friends' getaways, and corporate retreats across Ethiopia.

Foreigner.title: Foreigner Tours
Foreigner.subtitle: Airport-to-airport service for international visitors exploring Ethiopia.

Visa.title: Visa Processing
Visa.body: Visit, medical, and family visas — we handle documentation, submission, and status tracking from start to finish.

SmartForm.title: Smart Form
SmartForm.subtitle: Tell us what you need — we'll take it from there.
